result.title: ScanAR: Parallel Row-Scan Decoding for Efficient Image Generation in Unified Autoregressive Models
result.summary: Unified multimodal autoregressive (AR) models represent text and images in one token sequence and generate all modalities with a shared next-token prediction head. Their image generation, however, decodes an $H\times W$ visual grid token by token in raster order, which takes $HW$ sequential steps and dominates inference time. Existing acceleration methods for visual AR generation either change the tokenizer, the prediction head, or the model interface, or keep the model but cannot reach high parallelism without losing quality, so they do not carry over to unified AR models. We propose ScanAR, a row-scan parallel decoding method that only redefines the predecessors of visual tokens. The first visual row is generated from left to right as usual, and each later row is generated in a single parallel step, with every token predicted from the vertically aligned token of the previous row. Nonvisual tokens keep the standard autoregressive rule. ScanAR reduces the visual decoding depth from $HW$ to $H+W$ without changing the backbone, vocabulary, or output head and without adding parameters, and it supports both training from scratch and lightweight post-training. On Emu3.5-Image-34B, ScanAR post-training reaches a GenEval score of 82.36, the best among post-training acceleration methods trained on the same data, and generates $512\times512$ images $13.8\times$ faster than raster decoding under the same inference setting. On ImageNet, ScanAR trained from scratch has the highest throughput at every model size with FID comparable to raster LlamaGen. On the 34B Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 model, ScanAR preserves the overall quality of embodied scene generation, interleaved image-text generation, and video generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ScanAR：只重定义视觉 token 的前驱关系，首行仍按光栅顺序生成，之后每行在单步内并行生成，每个 token 由上一行垂直对齐位置的 token 预测，将视觉解码深度从 HW 降到 H+W；不改主干、词表或输出头，也不加参数，支持从头训练与轻量后训练，并在 34B 统一模型、ImageNet 与具身场景生成上验证速度与质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「改写 token 依赖结构以换取并行深度缩减、且保留共享预测头」的做法，可能为 LVR 中并行更新 latent 推理状态、压缩串行步数提供可供核查的线索；但论文面向图像生成加速，未涉及推理状态内容或视觉证据使用，迁移需自行验证。
